page.overview:
What is Elves?

Elves is a theme that was introduced in March of 2015. The theme revolves around four elves who can control elemental powers. A TV Special titled Elves: Unite the Magic aired on March 8, 2015, on the Disney Channel.

In 2016, it was announced that Netflix will produce and air an eight-episode animated series based on the theme. The episodes were aired in 2017.
